description: React component for transforming and displaying API request curl commands within a web UI, including handling user input, API calls, and formatting requests.

classes.name: TransformRequestPanel
classes.description: React functional component allowing users to input JSON request data, trigger transformation, and view the resulting curl command.

methods.name: formatCurlCommand
methods.description: Formats API request components into a complete curl command string with proper indentation.

methods.name: handleTransform
methods.description: Handles the process of parsing input JSON, calling the backend API to transform the request, and updating the UI with the formatted curl command.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl + Enter) to trigger the transform action.
